question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting the legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or close the linked PR and this issue as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`?
rationale: Automation can prove the release helper is affected and the open PR fixes that old surface, but current main removed the helper and repository guidance now points durable skill creation at Skill Workshop, which is a maintainer product-boundary decision.

options.title: Close Obsolete Helper Path
options.body: Close the open PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports the helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported creation path.

options.title: Refresh Legacy Helper Repair
options.body: Ask for or create a refreshed PR that intentionally restores or maintains the helper, adds the mixed-case parser tests, and explains the supported release/backport story.

recommendation.title: Close Obsolete Helper Path
recommendation.body: Close the open PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports the helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported creation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled helper and the current simplified skill-creator files both route most strongly through steipete-authored history.
